items.title: Alice Zeno Interview, 1958-12-10
items.q: Oh, I liked the judge very much. Stayed with him till he left this earth.

ctx.x: George Ranshaw had, I believe, nine girls and two boys. Ah, but that was a man. Worth imitating. He had such nice manners, so quiet, so serious, so charitable. Oh, I liked the judge very much. Stayed with him till he left this earth.

I was wondering if you could tell us any more about your grandmother. If you remember more about her. You told us a little bit about her the other day. How she taught you some of these Senegalese, Senegal words. Did she teach you some of the songs too? Yeah.
